title: ITK migration record
description: One downstream-visible ITK change, stored as YAML in records/itk<N>/YYYYMMDD_<Descriptor>.yaml. Every field is optional; {} is a valid record. Each field is defined only here; the template's comments are generated from these descriptions.

schema_version.description: Version of this schema the record follows.

title.description: One line naming the change. Defaults to the file-name descriptor split into words.

summary.description: Shown above the dropdown, so it is always visible in the guide. GitHub-compatible Markdown: CommonMark and pipe tables, explicit links, no MyST directives or roles, no GitHub alerts.
examples: What changed, and which downstream code it affects.

details.description: Longer explanation in the same Markdown subset as summary. The record must stand on its own; reuse anything relevant from the PR body.

actions.description: Steps downstream code must take, one per item. Shown outside the dropdown for high-impact records.
examples: What downstream code must change, one step per item.

categories.description: What kind of change this is. ApiRemoved, ApiDeprecated, ApiRenamed: public API. ResultsChange: numeric or behavioral output differs. DefaultChanged: a default value or option changed. FileFormat: what is read or written changed. Performance: speed or memory changed noticeably. CompilerEnvironment: compiler, language standard, or toolchain requirement. Dependency: third-party minimum or option. Policy: support or policy statement with no code change.

environment.description: Where downstream code must act: cxx (C++ code), python (Python code), cmake (CMake build), wrapping (wrapping configuration), data (files, test baselines).

impact.description: Approximate downstream impact; guidance only. high: breaks most or many downstream builds, needs non-trivial edits, or silently changes results in common or widely used code (Remove support for ITKv5 interfaces; Modern CMake interface libraries; NumPy image_from_array(arr.T) no longer transpose-equivalent). medium: breaks some projects with a mechanical fix such as a rename or a new minimum version (Minimum VTK 9.1; GetIndex() replaced by ComputeIndex()). low: a niche API with a loud, easy fix, or a notice with no action for nearly anyone (ITKVNLInstantiation removed; itk::Math::sqrteps changed by 1 ULP). A ResultsChange or DefaultChanged record is at least medium unless details explains why few users would notice. Unrated records are listed after rated ones.

pr.description: Number of the pull request that introduced the change. Set it once the draft PR is open; 0 is a drafting placeholder; -1 means no PR (a direct commit or a pre-GitHub change).

commits.description: Commits related to the change: the one that introduced it first, then follow-up fixes appended over time. Add hashes once they are final on main; a follow-up PR also goes in links.

links.description: Related issues, other PRs, and discussions, as full URLs.

deprecated_in.description: Release that deprecated the old form. Quote versions: "6.0", not 6.0.

removed_in.description: Release that removed, or will remove, the old form. Quoted.

legacy_guard.description: Macro that hides the old form until it is removed.

renames.description: Old-to-new names, rendered as a table.

examples.description: Code before and after the change, in literal blocks (|). Either side may be omitted; note explains the pair. language is one of cpp, python, cmake, shell, text.

hints.description: Freeform pointers that help people and agentic tools carry out the migration: scripts in Utilities/Maintenance/, sed or grep commands, search patterns, related documentation. Not shown in the generated guide.
